records.question: Michelangelo has 28 ceilings to paint. This week, he paints 12 of them. Next week, he will paint 1/4 the number of ceilings he did this week. How many ceilings will be left to paint after next week?
records.response:
Next week, he will paint 12/4 = 3 ceilings.
After next week, he will have 28 - 12 - 3 = 13 ceilings left to paint.
#### 13
